incidents.title: Anomaly monitoring maintenance pause and delayed resume
incidents.summary: On 2026-06-24, the auxiliary anomaly-monitoring cron pipeline failed to resume after an intentional maintenance pause because a runtime requirement and its cron environment were out of sync. The pipeline was restored at 2026-06-24T11:20:02Z and subsequently completed 13 hours of continuous validation with 157 successful scheduled runs. No effect on validator operation, the on-chain validator entry, delegations, or recorded uptime was identified in the records reviewed. This was an operational monitoring incident, not a validator service incident. A separate daily-status monitoring degradation remains open.
